001package dayplanner;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005import javax.swing.JTextField;
006
007/**
008 * Represents the Swing GUI search window. Extends {@link GUIWindow} to share
009 * common window configuration, layout, and component handling with other GUI
010 * windows such as {@link GUIAddWindow}.
011 */
012public class GUISearchWindow extends GUIWindow {
013    /**
014     * Create a new Swing GUI search window.
015     * 
016     * @param activities Instantiated ActivityList.
017     */
018    public GUISearchWindow(ActivityList activities) {
019        super(activities);
020    }
021
022    /**
023     * {@inheritDoc}
024     * 
025     * @return Title string for the search window.
026     */
027    @Override
028    public String getWindowTitle() {
029        return "DayPlanner - Search";
030    }
031
032    /**
033     * {@inheritDoc}
034     * 
035     * @return Header HTML text for the search window form.
036     */
037    @Override
038    public String getHeaderText() {
039        return "<html><b>Searching activities:</b></html>";
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * {@inheritDoc}
044     * 
045     * @return Subheader HTML text explaining search parameters are optional.
046     */
047    @Override
048    public String getSubHeaderText() {
049        return "<html>Fields are optional; leaving a text field blank means the search will ignore that parameter.</html>";
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * {@inheritDoc}
054     * 
055     * @return Action button label "Search".
056     */
057    @Override
058    public String getActionButtonLabel() {
059        return "Search";
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * {@inheritDoc}
064     * 
065     * @return Action command string "SEARCH".
066     */
067    @Override
068    public String getActionButtonCommand() {
069        return "SEARCH";
070    }
071
072    /**
073     * {@inheritDoc}
074     * 
075     * @return Array of field labels for the search form.
076     */
077    @Override
078    public String[] getFieldLabels() {
079        return new String[] {
080            "<html>Type <code>('home', 'school', or 'other')</code></html>",
081            "<html>Title <i>(keywords)</i>:</html>",
082            "<html>Starting time <code>(YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM)</code>:</html>",
083            "<html>Ending time <code>(YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM)</code>:</html>",
084            "<html>Comment:</html>",
085            "<html>Location <i>(if searching for Other Activity only)</i>:</html>"
086        };
087    }
088
089    /**
090     * {@inheritDoc}
091     * 
092     * @return true if search was performed, false if validation failed.
093     */
094    @Override
095    public boolean executeAction() {
096        return trySearch(activities, centerFields);
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * Input-validate and try to search for activities matching the criteria.
101     * 
102     * @param activities   Instantiated ActivityList.
103     * @param centerFields All of the JTextField instances in the order: type,
104     *                     title/keywords, start time, end time, comment, location.
105     * @return true if search was performed, false if validation failed.
106     */
107    public boolean trySearch(ActivityList activities, ArrayList<JTextField> centerFields) {
108        if (activities == null || centerFields == null || centerFields.size() < 4) {
109            addMessage("Internal error: missing form fields.");
110            return false;
111        }
112
113        // 1. Activity type (optional)
114        String typeStr = centerFields.get(0).getText().trim();
115        ActivityType type = null;
116        if (!typeStr.isEmpty()) {
117            type = ActivityType.parse(typeStr);
118            if (type == null) {
119                addMessage("Invalid activity type: \"" + typeStr + "\". Please enter 'home', 'school', or 'other', or leave blank.");
120                return false;
121            }
122        }
123
124        // 2. Title keywords (optional)
125        String titleStr = centerFields.get(1).getText().trim();
126        String[] keywords = null;
127        if (!titleStr.isEmpty())
128            keywords = titleStr.split("\\s+");
129
130        // 3. Start time (optional)
131        String sTimeStr = centerFields.get(2).getText().trim();
132        Time sTime = null;
133        if (!sTimeStr.isEmpty()) {
134            sTime = parseAndValidateTime(sTimeStr, "Starting time", false);
135            if (sTime == null)
136                return false;
137        }
138
139        // 4. End time (optional)
140        String eTimeStr = centerFields.get(3).getText().trim();
141        Time eTime = null;
142        if (!eTimeStr.isEmpty()) {
143            eTime = parseAndValidateTime(eTimeStr, "Ending time", false);
144            if (eTime == null)
145                return false;
146        }
147
148        // 5. Start vs End order (if both are provided)
149        if (sTime != null && eTime != null && sTime.compareTo(eTime) >= 0) {
150            addMessage("Ending time (" + eTime + ") has to be after starting time (" + sTime + ").");
151            return false;
152        }
153
154        // 6. Execute search
155        List<Integer> titleMatches = activities.findTitleMatches(keywords);
156        int count = 0;
157        for (int index : titleMatches) {
158            Activity act = activities.get(index);
159            if (DayPlannerUtils.matchesCriteria(act, type, sTime, eTime)) {
160                count++;
161                addMessage(count + ". " + act.toString());
162            }
163        }
164
165        if (count == 0)
166            addMessage("No activities matched your search request.");
167        else
168            addMessage("Found " + count + " matching " + (count == 1 ? "activity." : "activities."));
169
170        return true;
171    }
172}
